verdict.rationale: The pack has no explicit statement about AI-training use of customer data. The only relevant support is indirect: Appwrite is built for self-hosting on any Docker-capable system, with "full control over data location", so data can stay entirely on infrastructure the user manages. That is a workaround rather than a stated privacy commitment. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out for Appwrite Cloud, documented data-usage terms for its AI features, and independent corroboration.
